units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 61:4">Gen. R. s. 61</cite> (play on <cite ref="S00727"><he>קטורה</he></cite>) <he>קָטְרָה מצות וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <he>שמקוטרת</he>, v. <cite ref="S00823"><he>קָטַר</he> I</cite>) she wreathed (made a crown of) godly deeds &c.; Yalk. ib. 109; Yalk. Chr. 1073.—[Gen. R. l. c. <he>מן קטר</he>, a grammatical gloss, v. Yalk. Gen. l. c., and Ar. s. v. <cite ref="S00823"><he>קטר</he></cite> 2.]—Part. pass. <he>קָטוּר</he>; f. <cite ref="S00727"><he>קְטוּרָה</he></cite> &c.

<cite ref="Mishnah Middot 2:5">Midd. II, 5</cite> (ref. to <he>קְטֻרוֹת</he>, <cite ref="Ezekiel 46:22">Ez. XLVI, 22</cite>) <he>אין קְטוּרוֹת אלא שאינן מקורות</he> ‘fenced in’ means that they were not roofed; Yalk. Ez. 381.
